description_en: Queries the performance metrics of data sharing
description_zh: 查看数据共享的性能指标
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-data-share-performance --resource-group-id example-string --key adbpg_datashare_topic_count --start-time 2022-08-03T15:00Z --end-time 2022-08-03T15:10Z --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDataSharePerformance

parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需传入该参数
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the performance metric. To specify multiple metrics, separate the metric names with a comma (,). Valid values:

adbpg_datashare_topic_count: the number of shared topics.

adbpg_datashare_data_size_mb: the size of shared data in MB
parameters.help_zh:
性能参数名称，多个指标用英文半角（,）分隔，取值如下：

adbpg_datashare_topic_count：共享Topic数量。
adbpg_datashare_data_size_mb：数据共享数据量
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query. The time must be in UTC and in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The time must be later than the start time, in UTC, and in the y*\**dTHH:mm*Z format
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
